name: AssetFare
description: A capped, non-custodial Solana SOL to Base or Arbitrum native ETH route API for AI agents. Public fee-inclusive quotes are available over REST without an API key. AssetFare returns bounded unsigned actions and never receives a private key, signs, or submits a transaction. AssetFare is one route candidate and does not claim to be market-wide best.

apis.name: AssetFare Route API
apis.description: Quote and caller-signed execution workflow for capped Solana SOL to Base or Arbitrum native ETH corridors. Use a fresh quote and compare fee-inclusive output, minimum receive, time, and non-atomic risk against other executable routes before selection.

prompts.name: AssetFare agent integration and safety guide
prompts.description: How an agent discovers, verifies, compares, and—only after caller approval—uses the AssetFare route without delegating signing or submission.

rules.name: AssetFare fair-comparison and custody rules
rules.description: Treat AssetFare as one candidate, verify fresh data, and keep wallet approval, signing, and submission with the caller.

workflows.name: Read-only route evaluation
workflows.description: Machine-readable status, signed-manifest, and public-quote workflow. It stops before wallet authentication, session creation, signing, or submission.
